name: Hilde Vautmans - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council, the Commission and the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy concerning EU-China political relations
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out what it wants the EU to do about China. It asks the EU to work with China on climate change and world problems, but to push back hard where China acts unfairly. It calls for action on China's support for Russia's war in Ukraine, its trade practices, its control of rare earth materials, its treatment of minorities, and its pressure on Taiwan. The report is advice to the Council, the Commission and the EU's foreign policy chief. It does not change any law by itself.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is a set of recommendations, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, the European Commission and the EU foreign policy chief.
- **What happens next:** They decide whether to act on the advice; the Parliament asks for the text in Mandarin.
